transcript: Based on the customer feedback in the reviews table, the majority of reviews for thermal bottles praise the insulation quality and heat retention, though some customers have reported issues with durability (chipping paint) and defects (leaking). The tumbler reviews are generally positive regarding functionality, though one customer noted a minor issue with a squeaking straw.
